comment: pray.c gcrownu() lines 894 and 900: a lawful debug Monk is crowned while she knows the spell of her class gift and wields a weapon. She wishes for two blessed rubies, a blessed luckstone, a blessed spellbook of restore ability, an uncursed quarterstaff and 14 blessed potions of gain level, identifies everything with #wizidentify, throws an identified ruby at each of two peaceful white unicorns (Luck +5 each, the luckstone adds 3), learns restore ability from the book and drops it (so carrying() is false and class_gift stays SPE_RESTORE_ABILITY), wields the staff, and drinks the potions to experience level 15. On her quest home she chats with a forced peaceful Grand Master and answers y to the debug 'adjust?' question in is_pure(), which sets her alignment record to 20 (PIOUS) without the moves-based ALIGNLIM cap. Back on level 1 she searches twice and prays, forcing success; pleased() pats her on the head and rn2((Luck+6)>>1) picks the crowning case. gcrownu() replaces obj with uwep because restore ability is a known spell (894) and the lawful arm skips the long-sword bonus because a class gift was given (900). The final keys dismiss the remaining --More-- prompts.
